events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up with product discovery, guided and self-guided meditation experiences, and skincare sampling inside Vanderbilt Hall.
events.what_is_free: Public pop-up access, Tatcha product discovery and samples. Limited guided meditation sessions can be reserved; self-guided meditation spots are also available first-come when available.
events.caveats: Reservations are available for limited guided meditation sessions, but self-guided meditation spots are also advertised on a first-come, first-served basis. Do not imply that a reservation guarantees general pop-up entry beyond the reserved session.
events.practical_notes: Vanderbilt Hall at Grand Central Terminal. Monday Sept. 21 is listed 9 AM–7 PM by NYC for FREE; Tuesday Sept. 22 is 8 AM–7 PM. Secondary listings differ on Monday opening time, so the date-specific hours preserve the more detailed current listing.

events.address: Chief Clubhouse, 13 E 19th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive sustainable-home experience with room-by-room brand activations, product sampling, a Gifting Garden and stage conversations during Climate Week NYC.
events.what_is_free: Registration is free. The experience advertises product sampling and a Gifting Garden alongside talks and activations.
events.caveats: Current independent Climate Week/UNGA event-map verification states that access is free but organizer approval is required. Submitting registration is therefore not confirmation of admission.
events.practical_notes: Runs Sept. 21–22 at Chief Clubhouse. The independent event map lists 8:30 AM–4 PM each day, while the official Climate Week listing currently displays a 9 AM start for Sept. 21; verify confirmation details before arrival.

events.event_name: Light Hill: Art into Action Educational Gallery
events.what_it_is: A week-long Climate Week educational gallery presenting thirteen original works by twelve artists about methane pollution, emissions data and community health impacts.
events.what_is_free: The gallery is explicitly described by the official Climate Week NYC calendar as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The official calendar offers a registration action, but also explicitly describes the exhibit itself as free and open to the public. Registration is not treated as a proven admission requirement.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Sept. 21–27, 11 AM–6 PM, at 74 Franklin Street.

events.event_name: Graeter’s × The Paper Ice Cream Truck
events.address: Washington St between Little W 12th & Gansevoort St; then Castle Clinton Plaza across from 17 State St, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-stop Manhattan ice cream truck celebrating season two of Peacock's The Paper with Graeter’s limited-edition flavors and newspaper-themed moments.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary samples of the limited-edition Graeter’s 'Black, White, and Read All Over' ice cream bundle.
events.caveats: Open to the public; complimentary samples are promotional and should be treated as while supplies last even though no inventory guarantee is published. No advance RSVP requirement was found in the verified listings.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday Sept. 22 only. Meatpacking stop: 12–2 PM on Washington Street between Little West 12th and Gansevoort. Battery stop: 3:30–7 PM at Castle Clinton Plaza across from 17 State Street.
